ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.237). Bug-fix and polish iteration. The tab opens at half of the available height above the 35 px main-tab bar, with a top grip for a saved resize (minimum four pawn rows). The Work combo opens centered with a Filter Work title, shows Any only while filtering, excludes the already-selected WorkType and shows at most 10 rows with a thin scrollbar. A three-state Filter: Line/Palette/Both control (default Line, disabled until a Work filter exists) scopes the Work filter; Not inverts it wherever it applies; Pawn search always filters only pawn rows; a Clear button resets all filters. Exact WorkType identity is matched, so Patient does not match PatientBedRest. Lane cards are 135 px wide with 14 px passion icons. Passion icons use one shared resolver: VSE/Alpha Skills PassionDef.Icon when available, then WorkBoxIcon tinted by PassionDef.color, then vanilla colored UI/Icons/PassionMinor/Major textures, then the vanilla gray work-box icons; no icon for None; Def.LabelCap is used for passion text. Palette chips follow the saved workTypeOrder, fill top-to-bottom then left-to-right, and support Shift+wheel; a debug Mod Setting appends 60 visual-only WorkTypes for scroll testing. Work type and WorkGiver order use vertical drag-and-drop rows. Scrollbar input is handled before the scroll view and drawing after it; palette and matrix horizontal drags use separate owners, so the palette cannot cancel the matrix drag. See CREDITS.md for compatibility references; no third-party code or assets are bundled. Colonist-bar order, hover-based drag targets, ghost/colors, simple/manual Work-tab fixes, return button, right-click max, selection, Recommend/Details, auto-recommend, save/load and resurrection are kept. No profiles, schedules, equipment or multi-pawn. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
